name: Spatial Film
summary:
Spatial Film turns your Meta Quest into a personal immersive cinema - streaming cinematic VR180 and 3D films that surround you with breathtaking places, live performances, and moments captured in true stereoscopic depth.

SHOT ON PROFESSIONAL CINEMA GEAR
Our original films are captured on the Blackmagic URSA Cine Immersive - a professional immersive cinema camera - in 16K HDR, then expertly super-sampled and mastered for Meta Quest. The result is razor-sharp detail, deep dynamic range, and lifelike depth th
